_note: W1-c (2026-11-07), see mesen2-results/W1-c_20261107.md. Event flag #00 selects the idle sprite family (#10-#13 / anim $11 instead of #00-#03 / anim $01) for Will and for Shadow, so the 'Shadow flag' wording is wrong (Will took the flag-set path in 25 of the 26 scene_flag_init scenes, Shadow took the clear path in scenes $E7 / $E8). ClearSceneState zeroes flags $00-$0F and both enemy counters at every scene setup (164 of 164), so flag #01 cannot be carried into Itory (the exit fired right after #01 was forced in scene $01) and a kill with enemyNum 0 (scene $1B) sets no bit and is spawned again on every entry. A boss with the reward flag set ($0AA0 bit 0 for Castoth) is cleared at once by its own entry code. Dry-run only: npm run merge -- plans/extracted-audit/mesen2-results/specs/W1-c_notes.json --dry-run.

edit.find: The Itory Village exit is disabled while flag $01 is set. $01 is set by unrelated scripts (angel_village, undersea_tunnel, great_wall floor buttons); whether it is cleared on scene load was not traced.
edit.with: The Itory Village exit is disabled while flag $01 is set. ClearSceneState zeroes flags $00-$0F at every scene setup, so $01 is clear when scene $15 starts, whatever other scenes set. Inside scene $15 only it15_lily sets it (after its palette flash and WaitByte #7F) and clears it again; it15_kara waits for it.

edit.with: SetDungeonKillFlag (sets the enemyNum bit in wramFlags, so the enemy is skipped when the scene is set up again; an enemy whose enemyNum is 0 sets no bit and is spawned again on every entry)

edit.find: Uses StandardEnemyDefeatHandler for the win sequence.
edit.with: Uses StandardEnemyDefeatHandler for the win sequence. The entry code of ir29_castoth tests boss flag $0500 (TestWramFlag_Offset100 with index 0: byte $0AA0 bit 0, set by boss_clear_reward_handler once the stat catch-up is done); when it is set the actor zeroes enemiesRemaining and enemiesRemainingBcd and dies at once, so a rewarded Castoth is not fought again.
